scripts.dev: concurrently -n svc,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd Service && npm install && cd ../Frontend && npm install
scripts.test: cd Service && npm test && cd ../Frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
scripts.test:frontend: cd Frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
